the uptake of amastige form of the protozoan parasite Leishmania amazonensis by macrophages resembles receptor-mediated phagocyosis.

amastigote ingestion by mammalian cells, like the ingestion of IgG-oposnized erythrocyte, involves a series of steps that require energy expenditure by the host cells and that are mediated by the formation of phagocytic cup around the amastigotes.
